summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sistema de Flujo de Aprobación con Log de Trazabilidad y Corrección de Solicitudes. Backend: 17/18 tests passed (94%). Frontend: All UI features verified working correctly including historial modal, nivel indicators, correction flow, and admin nivel configuration.

minor.issue: Legacy solicitudes (created before nivel feature) don't have nivel_actual field. Test expects all solicitudes to have this field.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor hydration issue in server select dropdown (pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: Historial de trazabilidad correctly stores events in MongoDB as array within solicitud document
Each event includes: id, timestamp, accion (CREACION/APROBACION_NIVEL/APROBACION_FINAL/RECHAZO/CORRECCION), usuario info, descripcion, estatus changes, motivo
Niveles de aprobación configurable per catalog (1-3 levels) stored in config_catalogos collection
Correction flow properly resets nivel_actual to 1, increments version, clears aprobaciones array
Timeline UI shows events with appropriate icons (Plus for creation, Check for approval, X for rejection, Edit for correction)
Admin-only 'Configurar Niveles de Aprobación por Catálogo' section correctly hidden from non-admin users
seed_data_creation: Test solicitudes created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sistema de Trazabilidad fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/historial returns timeline with events sorted by timestamp desc. 2) PUT /api/sistema/catalogos/{id}/niveles configures 1-3 approval levels (Admin only). 3) PUT /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/corregir allows solicitante to correct rejected solicitudes, resets to nivel 1, increments version. 4) POST aprobar increments nivel or approves final based on niveles_requeridos. 5) POST rechazar changes status to 'Rechazada - Pendiente Corrección'. 6) UI shows nivel indicators (dots), version badges, history buttons, and edit buttons for rejected solicitudes.

historial_trazabilidad_api.details: GET /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/historial returns complete timeline with CREACION, APROBACION_NIVEL, APROBACION_FINAL, RECHAZO, CORRECCION events

historial_modal_ui.details: Modal shows timeline with icons, timestamps, status transitions, rejection reasons, and comments

nivel_indicators_ui.details: Solicitudes table shows nivel dots (green=approved, amber=current, gray=pending) and 'Nivel X/Y' badges

configurar_niveles_api.details: PUT /api/sistema/catalogos/{id}/niveles correctly validates 1-3 range and updates config_catalogos collection

configurar_niveles_ui.details: Admin-only section shows 9 catalogs with dropdown selectors (1-3 niveles) and approval flow descriptions

corregir_solicitud_api.details: PUT /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/corregir updates datos, increments version, resets nivel to 1, changes status to 'Reenviada'

corregir_modal_ui.details: Modal pre-loads original data, shows rejection reason, allows editing and resubmission

edit_button_visibility.details: Edit button only visible for solicitudes with status 'Rechazada - Pendiente Corrección'

multi_level_approval_flow.details: Tested 2-level approval: Level 1 approval moves to 'Pendiente Nivel 2', Level 2 approval completes with 'Aprobada'

rejection_creates_historial.details: Rejection adds RECHAZO event with motivo to historial, changes status to 'Rechazada - Pendiente Corrección'
